title: Evidence
description: A single, sourced claim gathered while investigating a Lead. Distinct from a Signal (a detector's raw output) and from an Inference (a conclusion drawn from evidence) — see docs/contracts/evidence.md.

claim.description: One sentence, concretely falsifiable, e.g. 'Payment of 842000 MXN occurred on 2026-08-13.'

strength.description: DIRECT: proves the claim outright. CORROBORATING: supports another piece of evidence. CIRCUMSTANTIAL: consistent with but does not prove the hypothesis.

gathered_by_step_id.description: investigation_step step_id that produced this evidence.
